newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle off $0.50-1.00 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were slow, prices were $0.50 to $1.00 cheaper.
Steers - high select and choice 2-3 1200-1400 lbs 64.50- 67.00, part load 67.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 61.50-64.50. Select 1-2 58.50-61.50.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs 64.00- 66.00, couple part loads 67.00. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 60.50-64.00. Select 1-2 58.00-60.50.
